applicant_utility.summary: This is an invitation-only award: you cannot apply for it directly, so your entire path runs through holding an offer by 20 October 2026 and then watching for the 21 October 2026 invitation. Eligibility hinges on an Admissions GPE of 7.0 or above, no prior New Zealand tertiary study, and an eligible masters programme, so applicants in the wrong Graduate School of Management course are excluded even with top grades. The credit itself only offsets up to a quarter of first-year tuition, so treat it as a discount to layer on top of your own funding, not as a budget you can study on.
applicant_utility.best_fit: High-achieving new international master's applicants with an Admissions GPE of 7.0 or above who can fund the remaining tuition and all living costs themselves.
application_readiness_checklist: Secure a conditional or unconditional offer for Semester One or Quarter Two 2027 before 20 October 2026
Confirm your intended programme is eligible (Graduate School of Management is limited to three named degrees)
Watch for the 21 October 2026 invitation email and complete the supplementary form in the portal promptly
Draft the personal statement early; it is an assessed selection criterion alongside your Admissions GPE
Plan to accept the offer within the window in the notification and to complete two consecutive semesters of full-time study
common_rejection_risks: Missing the 4 November 2026 supplementary form deadline after receiving the invitation
Admissions GPE below 7.0 or no conditional/unconditional offer by 20 October 2026
Prior tertiary study in New Zealand (exchange excepted) or prior enrolment at the University
Enrolling in an excluded Graduate School of Management programme
Failing to accept the award by the stated date, which forfeits the offer
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: At least 75% of the first year's tuition fees plus all living costs, insurance, Student Services Fee and travel; the credit applies to tuition for the first two semesters only.
document_audit: The supplementary form is reachable only via the portal link sent by the Scholarships Office, so a stale email address or an over-aggressive spam filter can silently end your candidacy
The personal statement is the only written material assessed, so a generic or recycled statement is directly penalised in selection
alerts: If you do not complete at least two consecutive semesters of study you will normally be required to repay the full value of the scholarship
The award cannot be held concurrently with any other tuition fee paying scholarship funded by the International Office
Distance and University of Auckland Online enrolments are ineligible, as is deferring commencement except on compelling medical or adverse personal grounds approved by the Director
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Offer held by 20 Oct 2026 → invitation email 21 Oct 2026 → supplementary form and personal statement in the portal by 4 Nov 2026 → selection committee → Vice-Chancellor grants.

official.description: The University of Auckland Doctoral Scholarship (UoADS) is a competitive scholarship scheme in four rounds each year. In 2026 it comprises a tax-free stipend of $35,468 per annum with an annual CPI adjustment for up to 42 months FTE, tuition fees and the Student Services Fee for up to 42 months FTE, and the single student Health Insurance compulsory charge for international students, if applicable.

verification.notes: Stipend, tuition, Student Services Fee and health insurance components, the four 2027 rounds and the domestic-fee eligibility restriction confirmed on the official doctoral scholarships page and the Specific Terms in force 17 March 2026.

applicant_utility.summary: There is no separate scholarship form: you are considered as soon as you apply for the doctoral programme, provided you tick the scholarship consideration box in the application. The timing trap is enrolment — applicants must not enrol before the outcome is advised, and each of the four annual rounds carries its own prescribed enrolment date that differs for domestic and international candidates. If you hold other doctoral funding you should say so in the application, because the award cannot be combined with University-funded doctoral scholarships or foreign-government postgraduate awards.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Domestic candidates and fee-domestic international PhD applicants whose research aligns with the University's or their faculty's strategic priorities.
application_readiness_checklist: Tick the scholarship consideration option in the doctoral programme application
Do not enrol before the scholarship outcome is advised
Read your faculty or institute's published doctoral scholarship strategy and selection criteria before drafting your research proposal
Diary the prescribed enrolment window: four calendar months after grant for a domestic qualifying programme, seven months for an international qualifying programme
Maori and Pacific applicants: verify the guaranteed-scholarship threshold of a New Zealand qualifying programme GPA of 7.0 or above
common_rejection_risks: Enrolling in the doctoral programme before consideration concludes, which can forfeit the award
Research or topic that does not align with University or faculty/LSRI/URC strategic objectives; a committee may nominate no one in a round
Already holding a doctorate or having previously received payment for a UoADS
Being enrolled in a doctoral programme without an approved transfer pathway
Missing the prescribed enrolment date in the letter of award
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: International travel, research and thesis costs beyond prescribed study, and any living costs above the tax-free stipend of $35,468 per annum.
document_audit: Everything rides on the doctoral application itself, so a research proposal that does not visibly map to published faculty strategies is the main weak point
Paid internship or placement income can suppress or pause the stipend; notify the Scholarships Office immediately when an internship is required or approved
alerts: Hard cap of 750 hours of additional paid work per 12-month period during the scholarship

Cannot be held with any other University-funded doctoral scholarship or a Universities New Zealand or foreign-government postgraduate award, and concurrent stipends cannot exceed 150% of the scholarship stipend
Enrolment suspension beyond 12 months terminates the scholarship, with a further 12 months possible for parental leave or compelling reasons approved by the Director
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Doctoral application with the scholarship box ticked → faculty/LSRI/URC advisory committee nominates → PVC GGR recommends → Vice-Chancellor grants → enrol by the prescribed date in the letter of award.
